coverage_decisions.decision: Use global distribution, climate/local factors and interdependence as overlap. Retain the OCR six-ecosystem comparison; do not import a different board’s full habitat list.
UK habitat and fishing overview checked only where relevant to Topic 03; detailed deciduous woodland studies are not substituted for the coral requirement.
Develop forest layers, adaptations, nutrient stores and water links. Reject inconsistent nutrient-rich-soil wording and the suggestion epiphytes take nutrients from their host.
Detailed temperate woodland case-study material is outside the required rainforest/coral focus. Existing Peru/Andros evidence is retained instead.

decisions: Kept the complete ecosystem comparison table and every Peru/Andros case-study paragraph, number, date, qualification and existing process diagram.
Separated nutrients from energy, and stores from transfers. Corrected the source claims that nutrient minerals evaporate, epiphytes normally feed on host plants, and rich forest proves rich soil.
Kept coral content explicitly in scope despite the selected other-board references lacking a comparable coral section; checked partnership, temperature and bleaching against NOAA.
The original 139 MB ecosystem reference remains local and unchanged; its public URL, hash and scope decisions are versioned because GitHub cannot store that binary as an ordinary file.
